cards.text: The writer of Acts opens with a note to a man named Theophilus, reminding him about his first book. That book was about all that Jesus began to do and to teach. Began, friend, and it ran right up to one VERY big day.

cards.question: The writer's first book about Jesus ran right up to which day?

answers.text: The day He was taken up to heaven
The day He was born in Bethlehem
The day He was baptized by John

cards.question: Before that day, Jesus gave instructions to the apostles He had chosen. He gave them through the ___.

cards.text: After His suffering, Jesus presented Himself to the apostles with many convincing proofs that He was alive. That's not a rumor, friend, that's a RECEIPT, and after years under useless receipts in my old junk drawer, trust me, I know which kind you keep.

cards.question: After His suffering, Jesus kept appearing to the apostles. Over how long?
Over those forty days, Jesus spoke to the apostles about the ___ of God.

cards.text: While they're all gathered together, Jesus gives them a command. And it starts with: don't leave.

cards.question: Jesus commands the apostles not to leave which city?
Along with staying in Jerusalem, what does Jesus command the apostles to do?

answers.text: Wait for the gift the Father promised
Fast and pray at the temple each day
Pick a new leader to guide them all

cards.text: Then Jesus brings up John, who baptized with water, and then He says "but." Friend, when a boss says "great year, BUT," I start sweating, so I'm glad THIS "but" is coming from Jesus.

cards.question: Jesus mentions John, who baptized with water, and then a baptism coming for the apostles. True or false: Jesus says their baptism is still many years away.
Jesus says John baptized with water, but in a few days the apostles will be baptized with the ___.

cards.text: So when the apostles come together, they've got a question for Jesus. A BIG one.

cards.question: The apostles have heard Jesus talk about the kingdom of God. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Will You restore the kingdom to Israel now
Who will lead us once You are gone
Will You take us with You to heaven

cards.text: Is it time YET? That's me opening the oven door every thirty seconds, friend, and now Jesus gives them His answer.

cards.question: True or false: When the apostles ask about the timing, Jesus tells them it is not for them to know.
Jesus says the times and seasons are fixed by the authority of the ___.

cards.text: But Jesus isn't finished, friend. He tells them what's coming when the Holy Spirit comes upon them.

cards.question: Jesus says that when the Holy Spirit comes upon them, the apostles will receive ___.
True or false: Jesus tells the apostles they will be His witnesses in Jerusalem only.
Starting in Jerusalem and going through all Judea and Samaria, how far does Jesus say the apostles' witness will reach?

answers.text: To the ends of the earth

cards.text: Jesus finishes speaking. And right there, as the apostles watch, He is taken up.

cards.question: As Jesus is taken up, a ___ hides Him from the apostles' sight.

cards.text: They're looking intently into the sky as He goes, friend. It's like watching a plane shrink to a dot and then staring at the empty spot like it owes you an explanation.

cards.question: True or false: While the apostles are staring into the sky, two men dressed in white suddenly stand beside them.

cards.text: Then the two men speak up: "Men of Galilee," they say, "why do you stand here looking into the sky?" Caught staring, friend, and that's me still gazing at the oven door after the batch is already OUT.

cards.question: What do the two men in white tell the apostles about Jesus?

answers.text: He will come back the same way He went
They will not see Him again on earth
They should go look for Him in Galilee

findings.problem: Unsupported prediction is the norm rather than the exception. Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker infer the requested detail on stop 1 cards 3, 6, 11 and 12 or stop 2 cards 4, 5, 7 and 8. Stop 1 cards 5 and 8 and stop 2 card 13 add further discovery questions. This goes well beyond a few discovery questions, and most choice cards are not informed guesses.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer. The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question. A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

findings.problem: "Before that day" depends on the previous card for its meaning. The question should identify the day itself, such as the day Jesus was taken up to heaven, rather than using "that" to point back to a card the baker can no longer see.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: "When the apostles ask about the timing" does not say what event's timing they are asking about. The question needs to supply the context of restoring the kingdom to Israel.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The answers are not the same kind of thing: "Holy Spirit" is a divine person, while "pure incense" and "sacred oil" are physical substances. The two distractors also make implausible things with which to be baptized, causing the right answer to stand out.

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly. Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.
